findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Tự học Tiếng Anh theo lộ trình, chinh phục từng " → 4 lines (18 words, 52px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 16 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "BreadTrans AI Tutor", "Trụ Cột Đột Phá", "Công Cụ Tương Tác Miễn Phí", "Hành Trình Chinh Phục").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.
Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 8 gradient fill(s): section.relative.overflow-hidden → linear-gradient(oklab(0.207998 -0.00311178 -0.0418783 / 0.9) 0%, lab(7.78673 1.82346 -15.0537) 50%, rgb(11, 17 | div.absolute.inset-0 → linear-gradient(to right top, lab(86.4156 6.13147 78.3961) 0%, lab(70.0429 42.5156 75.8207) 100%) | div.md:col-span-2.bg-gradient-to-br → linear-gradient(to right bottom, lab(7.78673 1.82346 -15.0537) 0%, lab(7.78673 1.82346 -15.0537) 50%, rgb(20,
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "Đăng ký" 3.2:1 needs 4.5:1; "miễn phí" 3.2:1 needs 4.5:1; "Bắt đầu học" 3.2:1 needs 4.5:1; "Bắt đầu học" 3.2:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.

findings.message: 1 text block(s) sit within 16px of the screen edge: "miễn phí" (2px from the right)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–32px or more). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.
One radius for panels, one for controls, full round only for pills and avatars.

findings.message: 13 icons sit in tinted squares or circles in 6 different colours.
findings.fix: This is the commonest tell of a generated dashboard. Drop the tinted square: a KPI is a label and a number; an icon, if it helps, is plain and in the text colour.

findings.message: 6 text blocks under 11px: Phát âm 10px, Trôi chảy 10px, Mục tiêu format 10px, Sau 70 ngày 10px.
Only 2 of 21 blocks start on the first 1440px screen.
findings.fix: Every block the brief names shows its header and first rows on the first desktop screen: size the headline block to its question, cap long lists with "View all", and put time-sensitive blocks before long tables.

findings.message: 2 card(s) hold a blank band inside: 49px in "Chỉnh Phát Âm Chuẩn Âm Vị IPA & Ngữ Điệu", 46px in "Lê Hoàng Đức".
findings.fix: A card stretches to its neighbour only when it has content to fill. Keep a legend or a note directly under its chart (only an action or a total may sit at a stretched card's foot), let a short card keep its own height (align-items: start), and let a filtered block shrink to its rows.

findings.message: The h1 is 52px ("Tự học Tiếng Anh theo lộ trình, chinh ph").
findings.fix: An app screen is not a landing page: the title is 18-32px (20-24px on a phone).
